summary: Iteration 8 is a light regression smoke check confirming that adding explanatory comments inside three intentional empty catch blocks (device.js, i18n.jsx, AuthContext.jsx) is behaviorally a no-op. Frontend compiles cleanly, admin login works end-to-end, EN<->HI language toggle persists across reload (localStorage.jp_lang), device id (jp_device_id) is generated by crypto.randomUUID, sent on login body, and preserved across reload+logout, logout clears jp_token and redirects to /login, ceramic/yard tabs render, yard search filters correctly, and 'Open in Maps' links carry target=_blank + valid Google Maps URLs. Non-admin 403 device binding + admin reset-device path was validated in iteration_7 pytest (test_device_binding.py, 11/11); no code paths were touched in this iteration so re-running was skipped per the request.
action_items: None — the three files only added inline comments inside pre-existing empty catch blocks; runtime is identical.
critical_code_review_comments: device.js: fallback path (`dev-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()...}`) is only used if crypto.randomUUID throws OR localStorage throws entirely. The Safari private-mode branch returns a fresh id every call, so device binding cannot work in that mode — acceptable tradeoff and comment now documents it.

AuthContext.logout swallows the /auth/logout error and still clears localStorage — this is correct behavior and iteration_7 already noted the server-side endpoint returns 401 for users whose device was reset; the comment now records that intent.
i18n.jsx setLang: setLangState fires first, then the localStorage.setItem is attempted; on Safari private mode the state still updates. Comment now documents this ordering.

success_rate.backend: n/a (not re-run; iteration_7 was 11/11 and backend files were not touched)
success_rate.frontend: 6/6 smoke checks passed (login, device id persistence, jp_token set, lang toggle+reload, tabs+search+maps, logout redirect)

seed_data_creation: None. Smoke test only logged in with the seeded admin and did not mutate any data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest for this project MUST use `-n 0` — pytest.ini defaults to `-n 2 --dist loadscope` which will race admin logins across xdist workers. Device binding: getDeviceId() reads/writes localStorage['jp_device_id'] as crypto.randomUUID. Login body carries device_id. Admin JWT has did=null (that is expected and get_current_user short-circuits on role=admin before reading did). Language toggle uses localStorage['jp_lang'] with 'en'|'hi'. Logout swallows POST /auth/logout errors intentionally; frontend clears jp_token and redirects to /login regardless.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — this iteration was a documentation-only change. Smoke run confirms no regression.
